This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Guswan Askreeth]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin and black eyes.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species, the [[cyborg]] [[Colonel]] [[Guswan Askreeth]], was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Guswan_Askreeth_concept.png|thumb|right|200px|Pearl General 05 by Tim Napper]]
The species made their debut in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer [[Tim Napper]], and concept art for them was title "Pearl General 05."<ref name="Napper">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
